style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 40cm Classic Christmas Acorn & Winter Foliage Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: <p>For a gorgeous transitional piece in your seasonal decorating, look no further than the Classic Acorn &amp; Winter Foliage Wreath. A natural twig circle base is set with delicate sprays of faux pine and eucalyptus and is dotted with glossy acorns and white berries. </p><p>This unlit wreath beautifully complements a neutral decorative scheme, so we’d hang it up over a minimal mirror, or prop it up on a white or grey painted mantlepiece along with our matching Classic Acorn Garland. Alternatively, we’d suggest winding some warm white LEDs around the foliage and hanging the wreath up in the kitchen, to bring a bit of woodland magic to your autumn and winter.&nbsp;</p><p>All wreaths and garlands will require styling on arrival, lay flat and tease the foliage for a styled and finished look. Shaping your foliage may result in some variance from the listed dimensions.&nbsp;</p><ul><li>(D) 40cm </li><li>Unlit Wreath</li><li>Size : ONE</li></ul>
